failure_raw.prompt: Inspect this in-car image. Return one strict JSON object with exactly one scalar string value for every key. For each key, choose one item from its allowed-values list, or use UNKNOWN when it is not visible. Do not return arrays and do not repeat the schema. Allowed values: {"in_car_light": ["OFF", "ON"], "env_light_discrete": ["HIGH", "MEDIUM"], "gender": ["FEMALE", "MALE"], "emotion": ["HAPPY", "SERIOUS"], "driver_tshirt_color": ["BLACK", "WHITE"], "phone_driver": ["NO", "YES"], "safety_belt": ["NO", "YES"], "env": ["GARAGE"], "suitcase": ["NO", "YES"], "phone_codriver_seat": ["NO", "YES"], "phone_codriver_seat_color": ["BLACK"], "colabottle_codriver_seat": ["NO", "YES"], "colacan_codriver_seat": ["NO"], "baby_seat": ["NO", "YES"], "suitcase_color": ["ANTRACITE", "YELLOW"], "suitcase_location": ["REAR_SEAT"], "suitcase_pose": ["FLAT", "UPWARDS"], "baby_seat_orientation": ["FRONT_FACING", "REAR_FACING"], "baby": ["NO", "YES"]}
